addons.name: Original WonderLang: Single Platform
addons.text: The complete original game on your choice of PC/Mac, Android, or iOS. All learning languages and future language updates included.
addons.included: The original game is already included from The Complete Adventure, including Language Hero and Language God.
addons.applies: Choose this or the original-game multiplatform add-on. If you already own the original game, you do not need to buy it again.

addons.name: Original WonderLang: Multiplatform
addons.text: The original game on PC/Mac, Android, and iOS, including cross-platform cloud saves and all learning languages.
addons.included: Already included from The Complete Adventure and in every tier with the Lifetime Language Pass.
addons.applies: An alternative to the original-game single-platform add-on, not an upgrade that needs both purchases. Existing owners can keep their original license.

addons.name: Beyond Multiplatform Upgrade
addons.text: Take your Beyond copy to PC/Mac, Android, and iOS, with unlimited personal mobile devices and cloud saves.
addons.included: Already included in Multiplatform Adventurer and all higher game-access tiers.

addons.name: Digital Soundtrack
addons.text: A digital copy of the WonderLang Beyond soundtrack.
addons.included: The standalone soundtrack download is an optional extra, not listed among the reward-tier benefits.
addons.applies: Available alongside any reward. A fully commissioned original score depends on the €80,000 stretch goal.

addons.name: Digital Artbook
addons.text: A digital collection of concept art, illustrations, and behind-the-scenes content.
addons.included: The standalone digital artbook is an optional extra, not listed among the reward-tier benefits.

addons.name: Extra Copy of WonderLang Beyond
addons.text: An additional single-platform digital copy to gift to someone, with all learning languages.
addons.included: A separate license for another person. This adds a gift copy rather than duplicating your personal device access.
addons.applies: Choose PC/Mac, Android, or iOS for the gift copy. Available alongside any reward.
